pr_title: Simplify multidict value resolution for sequence fields
pr_description: _get_multidict_value special-cased Json-typed fields to bypass getlist, adding an extra field_info.metadata scan on every lookup. This removes the _is_json_field helper and lets is_sequence_field alone decide whether to pull from getlist, keeping the resolution path uniform across field types.
